description: Turn any oven recipe into air fryer settings: 25F lower for the full time, or the same temperature and check about a quarter sooner. Pick your food and convert.
intro: Nearly every recipe on the internet is written for the oven, and the air fryer cooks hotter and faster than the oven does. The conversion is one small move, and you pick which one: take 25F off the temperature and keep the oven time, or keep the oven temperature and check about a quarter sooner. A recipe that bakes at 425F for 25 minutes becomes either 400F for 25 minutes or 425F and check at about 19 minutes.

Some guides say do both, lower the temperature and cut the time. That undercooks, because you have taken heat away twice. This converter gives you the choice, and states plainly which one changed. The converted numbers are a starting point, not a promise. The thermometer decides when meat is done, and your eyes decide when everything else is.

Each converter below is for one food, with its own typical oven settings, its own presets, and its own table. Pick the food in your recipe, type in the oven settings, and the answer updates as you type. Start with the dish you cook most, and the rest follows.
